Hi Stephanie —

Thanks again for the demo yesterday. As discussed, we want to move forward with an evaluation run and need a short mutual action plan (MAP) plus the evaluation material bundle (test cases + prompt pack + sample dataset). Our procurement team will need usage constraints documented up front.

High level asks:
- MAP with milestones to close (goal: PO / signed MAP within 2 weeks)
- Secure transfer of evaluation dataset + prompt pack with clear retention & redistribution rules
- A single contact for legal / security questions (procurement will loop in ours)

Can you send over a scaffold MAP and the materials we discussed? If you have a standard data-exchange addendum, please include.

Thanks,

Cc: Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.ai>, Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 30 Oct 2026 11:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: MAP / evaluation materials exchange

Sam —

Appreciate the follow-up. Attached is a compact MAP (MAP_Milestones.xlsx) that scopes milestones through PO/signature and a ZIP with the evaluation materials. I’ve included our standard Data Exchange Addendum (DEA v1.1) as a starting point.

Key points in our proposed exchange:
- Delivery: secure link (see below) to download: eval_dataset_sample.tar.gz, prompt_pack_v1.jsonl, plus a small set of labeled test cases.
- Access window: 90 days from first download (automatically revoked unless extended by written request).
- Use: evaluation-only; no redistribution; derivatives allowed only for integration testing but not for public release.
- Retention & deletion: dataset must be deleted within 30 days after evaluation window closes unless an NDA addendum is in place.
- Audit: we will provide access logs on request for the 90-day window.

Secure download (expires 2026-11-15): https://redwood-secure-share.example.com/s/bytewave-eval-2026
Attachments (stubs):
- [Attachment: eval_dataset_sample.tar.gz (2.1GB)]
- [Attachment: prompt_pack_v1.jsonl (12MB)]
- [Attachment: MAP_Milestones.xlsx]
- [Attachment: Data_Exchange_Addendum_v1.1.docx]

Next steps I propose (compact MAP):
1) Review DEA & MAP (this week) — ByteWave legal/eng
2) Redwood to incorporate any permissible redlines (2 business days) — Markus
3) Exec sign & DocuSign (target: 2026-11-11)
4) Dataset handed off & evaluation kickoff (target: within 48h of signature)

Looping in Markus (legal) and Neha (security) for quick redline and PII controls. Happy to jump on a 30-min call if helpful.

Best,
Stephanie Nguyen

Sam / Stephanie —

Thanks for circulating the addendum. Quick legal notes / proposed redlines (high level):
- Clarify license scope: evaluation-only, non-commercial, no redistribution, and explicit prohibition on sublicensing.
- Deletion windows: we prefer 90 days access + 30 days for cleanup; you proposed 90 days for access and 30 days for post-window deletion — that is acceptable, we will add an audit clause requiring written confirmation of deletion.
- Export controls: add a standard export-control representation for both parties.
- Liability cap: align to existing SOW/deal cap; if there is a procurement requirement for higher cap, we’ll need to route to sales leadership.

I’ve uploaded a marked PDF with inline redlines: redlines_MARKUS_20261030.pdf (attached). If ByteWave can confirm the no-redistribution and no-sublicense language, we can turn the DEA into a signature-ready DocuSign packet.

-MK
